payload.instruction: Turn the image into a drawing made from chalk
payload.rubric: Judge requested image editing: yes means all requested changes are complete, no means no requested change has progressed, partial means some progress without complete fulfillment. Unrelated edits are not requested progress. Insufficient evidence stays unresolved.

node.question: Does the edited image visibly present its depicted content as a drawing rather than as a photograph with effects?
node.criteria: pass: affirmative drawing-style rendering is evident across the depicted content, not merely outlines, grain, blur, or surface effects over photographic detail; fail: the content remains visibly photographic without drawing conversion; unknown: the rendering does not resolve whether the content is drawn or photographic.
node.binding: Assess only drawing conversion of the depicted content, independently of medium; do not treat texture or outlines alone as sufficient.
